subject: general
question: Select the correctly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Mathematics**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correctly spelled word is '**Mathematics**.'
 
• **Mathematics** means the study of numbers, quantities, and space as abstract ideas (pure mathematics).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mathematics** means as are used in other fields like physics and engineering ( applied mathematics ).

• **Algebra**
 
• **Geometry**
 
• **Calculus**
